closing_reason: Procurement opted for AWS SageMaker Endpoints to align with existing enterprise contracts and centralized key management; faster procurement windows and lower perceived integration risk.
notes:
Summary: 
- Engaged Oct 2025 via inbound demo request (legacy NLP platform migration).
- Use case: customer support assistant + document search for compliance teams; must support PII redaction, low 1st-byte latency for agent UX, and audit trails.
- Initial rep: Sofia Patel. SE: Marcus Liang. Security touchpoint: 2/04 meeting.
- 11/20/25 discovery call: infra team stressed single-vendor cloud consolidation (AWS first). Quote: "We want to standardize on one cloud provider for model endpoints to avoid multiple vendor SLAs."
- 12/12/25 demo: Redwood Dedicated perf + batching demo; good engagements on latency numbers, SE ran small perf sim (Drive: pricing-deck-v3).
- 01/21/26 POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_2026-01-21_opal-demo). POC scope: 10k concurrent tokens/day, 99th pct < 450ms, KV prefix caching to cut cost.
- 02/04/26 security deep-dive (Fireflies ff_2026-02-04_security-review). Security asked for key-wrap integration with existing AWS KMS & centralized audit; legal requested liability language tied to managed KMS.
- Procurement timeline slipped due to enterprise-wide budget hold; meanwhile infra completed evaluation of managed endpoints.
- 02/18/26 final sync: Procurement confirmed selection of AWS SageMaker Endpoints. Primary drivers: existing enterprise AWS MSAs, integrated AWS KMS + IAM, and perceived lower procurement friction. SE note: integration work for Redwood Private would have been straightforward but required separate legal review and added 3-4 week procurement window.
Decision notes / reasons lost: 
- Lost to hyperscaler managed endpoints (AWS) — consolidated vendor decision.
- Budget and procurement momentum favored hyperscaler (contract reuse).
- No sustained internal champion after infra lead moved teams (no internal product sponsor).
- Security preferred managed KMS and single-pane logging tied to existing CloudTrail workflows.
Open items / follow-ups: 
- Churn monitoring: watch for rollout issues on SageMaker; potential re-evaluation in 6-9 months.
- Marketing intel: capture quote about procurement friction for SMB/enterprise win patterns.
- Hand off to market-intel + PS for post-mortem (Drive: security/soc2-assessment-notes.docx).
